Header.DiffConfiguration: Difficulty Configuration (multipliers under this header are multiples of the preset difficulty values)
Description.MaxAndSpawnedPopulationMulti: Requires overpopulation Awakened Dream to be active.
Description.EnemyMovementSpeedMultiplier: Adjust the movement speed of enemies.
Description.EnemyAttackSpeedMultiplier: Adjust the attack speed of enemies.
Description.EnemyAbilityHasteFlatMultipl: Adjust the ability haste of enemies.
Description.EnemyAttackDamageMultiplier: Adjust the attack damage of enemies.
Description.EnemyAbilityPowerMultiplier: Adjust the ability power of enemies.
Description.EnemyArmorMultiplierAddByZon: Multiplier for additional armor in each zone.
Description.EnemyExtraHealthGrowthMultip: This value grows exponentially. For example, if the monster's base health is 100 and the current level is 10, with a multiplier of 2, the health becomes 100 * 2^10 = 204,800.
Description.EnemyExtraDamageGrowthMultip: Same as the Enemy Extra Health Growth Multiplier.
Description.LittleMonsterHealthMultiplie: Adjust the health of little monsters.
Description.LittleMonsterDamageMultiplie: Adjust the damage of little monsters.
LabelText.LittleMonsterMirageChanceMulti: Little Monster Mirage Skin Chance Multiplier
Description.LittleMonsterMirageChanceMul: Adjust the chance of little monsters having a mirage skin.
Description.MiniBossHealthMultiplier: Adjust the health of mini bosses.
Description.MiniBossDamageMultiplier: Adjust the damage of mini bosses.
Description.BossCount: Set the total number of lord bosses for each lord boss spawn request.
Description.BossCountInRoom: Maximum number of lord bosses alive in the room at once. Remaining lord bosses wait in a queue.
Description.BossCountAddByLoop: Set how many lord bosses are added per loop.
Description.BossCountAddByZone: Set how many lord bosses are added per zone.
Description.MiniBossCount: Set the total number of mini bosses for each mini boss spawn request.
Description.MiniBossCountInRoom: Maximum number of mini bosses alive in the room at once. Extras wait in a queue.
Description.MiniBossCountAddByLoop: Set how many mini bosses are added per loop.
Description.MiniBossCountAddByZone: Set how many mini bosses are added per zone.
Description.BossMirageChance: Set the chance for bosses to have a mirage skin.
Description.BossHunterChance: Set the chance for a boss to become a hunter.
Description.BossSpawnAllOnce: Enable this option to fill all available boss slots immediately. The room limit still applies.
Description.BossSingleInjuryHealthMultip: Set the health multiplier for damage taken by the boss.
Description.HeroHealMultiplier: Adjust the healing effect of the hero. Values less than 1 will reduce healing.
Description.HeroMaxShieldMultiplier: Adjust the maximum shield of the hero.
Description.HeroShieldCoolDownSeconds: Adjust the cooldown time of the hero's shield.
LabelText.HeroIgnoreShieldCoolDownFromOt: Hero Ignores Shield Cooldown From Others
Description.HeroIgnoreShieldCoolDownFrom: Enable this option to allow the hero to ignore shield cooldowns from other sources.
Description.WorldReveal: Enable this option to activate World Reveal, similar to the Treasure World Reveal feature.
LabelText.SpawnLostSoulInCurrentRoom: Spawn Lost Soul in Current Room
Description.SpawnLostSoulInCurrentRoom: When a teammate is knocked out, spawn their Lost Soul in the current room instead of a later room.
LabelText.SpawnLostSoulInBossRoom: Spawn Lost Soul in Boss Room
Description.SpawnLostSoulInBossRoom: Allow a knocked-out teammate's Lost Soul to spawn in the current Boss Room.
